name: Assistants API v2 (beta)
summary: OpenAI Assistants v2 exposes `model` in four places: POST /v1/assistants, PATCH /v1/assistants/{id}, POST /v1/threads/{id}/runs (override), POST /v1/threads/runs (override).
description: The v2 Assistants API defines a persistent assistant with a default `model`, and each thread run can optionally override that model. This gives four distinct `model` slots on four endpoints. OpenAI has flagged v2 Assistants as being replaced by the Responses API, and Foundry's v2 agent surface (`PromptAgentDefinition` / `HostedAgentDefinition`) is the strategic successor tracked by the `prompt-agents-*` and `hosted-agents-*` cards. This card captures the legacy Assistants-v2 shape specifically so that anyone still on that API knows BYOM has not been validated for it and is unlikely to be.
notes: Status-only. Included for completeness because the Assistants v2 surface still ships in the OpenAI SDKs; the recommended migration is to Prompt Agents (see `prompt-agents-static` / `prompt-agents-dynamic`).
